Supply order for Ellmere depot. Personnel: Bram, Dell, Greta, Jonah, Pia, Leon, Cora, Mira, Suri, Nils, Una, Vik, Teo, Hugo, Wren, Kira, Ines, Ada, Opal, Finn, Esme. Wren out; Leon covering. Esme out; Dell covering. Finn out; Greta covering. Ines out for rest of week; Vik covering. Kira out for rest of week; Rafe covering. Ada out for rest of week; Rafe covering.

Desk swaps: Cora/Una, Hugo/Finn, Greta/Ines, Jonah/Nils, Pia/Ines, Kira/Opal, Bram/Wren, Ines/Vik, Teo/Kira, Teo/Esme, Mira/Ines, Nils/Una, Rafe/Ines, Opal/Dell. Rafe/Teo swapping this week.

Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, garden studio, harbour room are slow. Various temperature complaints. Umbrellas in loading bay, garden studio, north office, east wing, harbour room. Coffee machines in print room and loading bay working again.

Repainting: East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, north office, library annex, print room (noise). East wing noise in afternoon. Garden studio noise in evening.

Order items: 430 crates, 400 ladders, 520 lamps.

Notes: Morning stand-up moved to library annex. Evening stand-up moved to garden studio. Una thinks garden studio too cold in morning. Opal wants garden studio and library annex clear. Suri wants library annex clear. Vik prefers east wing for reviews. Nils prefers print room for reviews. Finn wants north office kept clear for visitors. Rafe wants garden studio kept clear for visitors. Nils now wants garden studio kept clear for visitors. Meeting notes pending for Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, Kira, Jonah, Hugo, Cora, Bram, Leon, Nils, Greta, Rafe. Notes pending for Jonah and Vik. Bram asked if library annex is free in the morning. Harbour room repainting causes morning noise. Lift near north office slow today. Notes from morning meeting still pending for Finn.
